description: This file is a Svelte component implementing an authentication page, handling user sign-up, login, logout, and displaying authentication state.

methods.name: handleSignup
methods.description: Handles user registration, manages form state, error handling, and updates UI upon success or failure.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login, redirects upon success, manages errors, and updates UI state.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Logs out the user, resets form state, handles errors, and updates UI accordingly.
